steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ugh! They're still fighting back!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Skullshatterer!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: As long as we can push them back, victory will be ours!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Right now... we have no choice but to fight.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: These guys... are pretty tough!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Gaah-! Damn, that shield of yours...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Sh-she's the one from the L.G.D...!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's not too late to put down your weapons and surrender...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Unless you want to die in vain right here.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You'd expect us to believe you?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Liar! Ursus... they've said the same thing before. But they executed those Infected, one by one...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I hid beneath the bodies of the slain, holding my breath, in order to survive.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: There are no depths to which your kind won't stoop... in order to exterminate us.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aren't you just trying to round us up so you can kill us faster?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Very well. You've made your choice then.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're not getting through to them, big fella. They won't listen to reason.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They can't even distinguish between good and even, Lungmen and Ursus.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: In that place... No, in many places...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Only hatred exists between those who are infected and those who are not.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It seems that because of that... all communication has broken down. Even though there's another path in front of our eyes.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Another path?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: What... could we possibly do?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: And what could you accomplish?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Don't waste any more time listening to their lies! Skullshatterer, let's get rid of them together!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Explosions?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: He's planning to surround us from multiple directions!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Our flank will collapse if we can't seize the initiative... Prepare to counterattack!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Skullshatterer! I'll cover you! Just kill them, and the battle will be over!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Skullshatterer...!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I have to go back... with all of you...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I have to...!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We don't have much time left!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm ready.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Act carefully. Don't show the enemy any signs of weakness.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I won't give them an opening!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Watch out, the enemy is charging forward!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Amiya! Stay away from the enemy...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Th-that's...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Doctor, what should I do...

options: You know what you have to do, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I don't want to...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Doctor... I...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Amiya...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why did you become like this...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Amiya... I guess this was our fate all along.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya! What are you doing? Hurry...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en? I...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's time...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...to put an end to this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There is one thing I must tell you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: From now on, you'd better treat all Infected the same way... ...as your enemies.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Life is unfair.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you want to hate someone, then hate me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: L.G.D.! Attack!
